title: textInputFocused suppresses for both notify-recipient (fieldFocus===3) and noti…
description:
textInputFocused suppresses for both notify-recipient (fieldFocus===3) and notify-sender (fieldFocus===4), but only the recipient branch is exercised by a test; the sender branch relies on symmetry. A dedicated fieldFocus===4 case would close the last uncovered sub-condition.

Source: cam/issue-316
Review round: 1

suggestion-fingerprint: 7868b92c0930

spec.scope: Add one dedicated test to test/ui/config-screen.test.tsx covering the fieldFocus===4 (notify-sender) TabBar Left/Right suppression sub-branch, which is currently only exercised for fieldFocus===3 (notify-recipient) and otherwise relies on symmetry. Test-only change: no production code (src/ui/ConfigScreen.tsx, src/ui/TabBar.tsx) is modified.
acceptanceCriteria: A new test in test/ui/config-screen.test.tsx focuses the Global tab's notify-sender field (fieldFocus===4) by tabbing forward 4 fields (backend -> merge-mode -> plan-approval -> notify-recipient -> notify-sender), awaiting each Tab individually, and waiting for the frame to contain 'resend_from'.

With the notify-sender NotifyTextInput focused, typing draft text then pressing RIGHT and LEFT does NOT switch tabs: the assertion confirms the frame still contains 'resend_from' and the typed draft, and does NOT contain 'Model for orchestrator:'.
The test mirrors the existing 'notify-recipient text field is focused (suppressed navigation)' test structurally (same LEFT-to-Global wrap, per-Tab awaits, RIGHT/LEFT suppression checks).
bun test test/ui/config-screen.test.tsx passes; the full suite baseline is unchanged except +1 passing test; typecheck is clean.
gotchas: notify-recipient is fieldFocus===3, notify-sender is fieldFocus===4; ConfigScreen.tsx:350 gates suppression on (currentTab==='global' && (fieldFocus===3 || fieldFocus===4)).
The notify-sender field renders NotifyTextInput with prompt 'resend_from (sender address, blank to leave unset):' (ConfigScreen.tsx:656); waitForFrame on the substring 'resend_from'.
Un-awaited stdin.write collapse in ink-testing-library: each TAB/RIGHT/LEFT write must be awaited individually via waitForFrame (see the existing recipient/Ship-tab tests' comments).
Reaching notify-sender needs 4 forward Tabs from field 0 after the LEFT wrap to Global, one more than the recipient test's 3.
